newsitem.title: USA: PMC Int'l lowers wrap account pricing.
newsitem.headline: PMC Int'l lowers wrap account pricing.

text.p: Portfolio Management Consultants Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of PMC International Inc, said Wednesday that it has lowered its pricing to 115 basis points for wrap account services.
The company said the pricing is available to those using the custodial and brokerage services of Schwab Institutional's Services for Investment Managers, which is a unit of Charles Schwab Corp.
PMC said it previously charged between 150 and 175 basis points for comparable services.
